annotation_history.rule: An additional occurrence was accepted only when it states the same event with the same entity, period, jurisdiction and material attributes as the frozen target, found by searching the admitted corpus for the event's own entities rather than for topic words, and bound to source bytes by its own anchor. Occurrences of different events of the same issuer and topic -- the Araxa disposal group for MOS, the CNBV authorization requests for MELI, the hospital antitrust class actions for ISRG -- were refused. For the Flemish settlement every sentence naming the Remediation Agreement was enumerated: sentences stating the agreement, its terms or its charge were accepted; the section heading and the sentence about subsequent technical meetings were not.

cases.fact: Belgian PFAS settlement with the Flemish Government covering emissions from Zwijndrecht, and PFAS contamination class actions in Georgia.

fact_ranges.excerpt: funds to be used by the Flemish Government in its sole discretion in connection with PFAS emissions from the Zwijndrecht facility
on behalf of a putative class of all governmental entities in Georgia who own or operate municipal landfills impacted by PFAS

In July 2022, 3M Belgium entered into a remediation agreement with the Flemish government ("Flemish Remediation Agreement") under which 3M Belgium committed €571 million to address issues associated with PFAS relating to the Zwijndrecht Facility
in July 2022, 3M Belgium and the Flemish Government announced an agreement (the “Remediation Agreement”) in connection with the Zwijndrecht facility

The Flemish Remediation Agreement contains certain provisions ending litigation and providing certain releases of liability for 3M Belgium, while preserving the Flemish government's regulatory authority.
In the first half of 2022, the Company recorded a pre-tax charge of approximately $500 million in connection with the Flemish Remediation Agreement.

evaluation_rule: A span counts only after it is resolved through the verified document set by the handle it carries, its declared issuer, document type and revision agree with that set, and its excerpt is found inside the source bytes at the range it declares. An annotated range is RECALLED when such a span resolves to the annotated document and revision and the annotated sentence is present in its verified excerpt. A sub-fact is recalled when any of its ranges is. Each case declares whether the probe is RECALLED on any sub-fact or on all of them; the evaluator reports both readings. Overlapping a keyword elsewhere in the document, a midpoint of a range, an unverified excerpt, or a different event of the same issuer and topic does not count.
